setup.question: How long does setup take?
setup.answer: It only takes 15–30 minutes to upload your menu and create your first QR code. Our technical team supports you so your restaurant can run the same day.

hardware.question: Do I need extra hardware?
hardware.answer: No. Scan Now runs on the web — you only need your existing phone or tablet to manage orders.

pricing.question: Does the 500k/month price include everything?
